title: Sign-offs
description: A run's sign-offs, in sign-offs.json of its folder: what waits for /rn:ty or /rn:gm, and what the user signed off or sent back. tree.py decides this form, and only tree.py writes it, as only the user's own /rn:ty or /rn:gm decides a sign-off.

sign_offs.description: Each sign-off, in the order put up.

sign_off.description: One sign-off: the plan, a deliverable, a lesson, or the pull request handed over.

what.description: The deliverable's path, the lesson's words word for word, or the pull request's URL; empty for the plan.

state.description: waiting: put up for /rn:ty or /rn:gm. signed off: the user typed /rn:ty. sent back: the user typed /rn:gm.

at.description: When it was put up, in ISO 8601, from which tree.py gets the user's comments since.
